records.query: MATCH (n:ExactCommerceNode) RETURN n.amount_coefficient AS amount_coefficient,n.amount_token AS amount_token,n.apply_batch_id AS apply_batch_id,n.currency AS currency,n.decimal_scale AS decimal_scale,n.entity_version AS entity_version,n.carrier_key AS graph_id,n.carrier_id AS id,n.logical_key_json AS logical_key_json,n.lookup_hash AS lookup_hash,n.original_key AS original_key,n.original_record AS original_record,n.props_json AS props_json,n.published_at AS published_at,n.quantity_long AS quantity_long,n.quantity_token AS quantity_token,n.retained_json AS retained_json,n.root_id AS root_id,n.schema_revision AS schema_revision,n.source_cursor_json AS source_cursor_json,n.source_delivery_id AS source_delivery_id,n.source_epoch AS source_epoch,n.source_feed AS source_feed,n.source_position AS source_position,n.source_system AS source_system,n.template_id AS template_id,n.type_id AS type_id,n.unit_price_coefficient AS unit_price_coefficient,n.unit_price_token AS unit_price_token,id(n) AS native_id

MATCH (s:ExactCommerceNode)-[n:ExactCommerceEdge]->(t:ExactCommerceNode) RETURN n.apply_batch_id AS apply_batch_id,n.dst AS dst,n.entity_version AS entity_version,n.carrier_key AS graph_id,n.carrier_id AS id,n.lookup_hash AS lookup_hash,n.order_key AS order_key,n.original_relationship AS original_relationship,n.props_json AS props_json,n.published_at AS published_at,n.rel_type_id AS rel_type_id,n.retained_json AS retained_json,n.schema_revision AS schema_revision,n.source_cursor_json AS source_cursor_json,n.source_delivery_id AS source_delivery_id,n.source_epoch AS source_epoch,n.source_feed AS source_feed,n.source_id AS source_id,n.source_position AS source_position,n.source_system AS source_system,n.source_type AS source_type,n.src AS src,n.target_id AS target_id,n.target_type AS target_type,id(n) AS native_id,id(s) AS native_src,id(t) AS native_dst

MATCH (f:ExactCommerceNode)-[fl:ExactCommerceEdge]->(l:ExactCommerceNode) MATCH (r:ExactCommerceNode)-[rl:ExactCommerceEdge]->(l) WHERE fl.original_relationship = 'fulfillments.line_id' AND rl.original_relationship = 'returns.line_id' RETURN [f.original_key,l.original_key,r.original_key] AS source_keys,l.quantity_long-f.quantity_long AS subtract,l.quantity_long-f.quantity_long+r.quantity_long AS add

MATCH (r:ExactCommerceNode)-[rr:ExactCommerceEdge]->(t:ExactCommerceNode) MATCH (t)-[tl:ExactCommerceEdge]->(l:ExactCommerceNode) MATCH (l)-[lp:ExactCommerceEdge]->(p:ExactCommerceNode) WHERE rr.original_relationship = 'refunds.return_id' AND tl.original_relationship = 'returns.line_id' AND lp.original_relationship = 'order_lines.product_id' RETURN [r.original_key,t.original_key,l.original_key,p.original_key] AS source_keys,t.quantity_long*p.unit_price_coefficient AS multiply_coefficient

MATCH (f:ExactCommerceNode)-[fl:ExactCommerceEdge]->(l:ExactCommerceNode) MATCH (r:ExactCommerceNode)-[rl:ExactCommerceEdge]->(l) WHERE fl.original_relationship = 'fulfillments.line_id' AND rl.original_relationship = 'returns.line_id' AND f.quantity_long<l.quantity_long RETURN f.quantity_long AS fulfilled,r.quantity_long AS returned,l.quantity_long-f.quantity_long+r.quantity_long AS remaining
MATCH (f:ExactCommerceNode)-[fl:ExactCommerceEdge]->(l:ExactCommerceNode) WHERE fl.original_relationship = 'fulfillments.line_id' AND f.quantity_long>l.quantity_long RETURN f.template_id AS id

MATCH (p:ExactCommerceNode)-[pi:ExactCommerceEdge]->(i:ExactCommerceNode) WHERE pi.original_relationship = 'payments.invoice_id' AND p.amount_coefficient=i.amount_coefficient AND p.currency=i.currency RETURN p.template_id AS id

MATCH (r:ExactCommerceNode)-[rr:ExactCommerceEdge]->(t:ExactCommerceNode) MATCH (t)-[tl:ExactCommerceEdge]->(l:ExactCommerceNode) MATCH (l)-[lp:ExactCommerceEdge]->(p:ExactCommerceNode) WHERE rr.original_relationship = 'refunds.return_id' AND tl.original_relationship = 'returns.line_id' AND lp.original_relationship = 'order_lines.product_id' AND r.amount_coefficient=t.quantity_long*p.unit_price_coefficient RETURN r.template_id AS id

scope: Actual opt-in finite coefficient representation; original logical domains/tokens retained; noDOUBLE/generalunbounded arithmetic.
